# Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Include the
motivation and context, and list any dependencies the change needs.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change

Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Translation or wording change
- [ ] This change requires a documentation update

## How has this been tested?

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes, and how to
reproduce them. For a change to a screen, add a screenshot, and check it in
light mode, dark mode and one long language such as German.

- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `make build` succeeds
- [ ] `make check-strings` passes

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the conventions in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] Every new user-visible string is in the String Catalogs and translated
- [ ] Every new clickable control uses `.clickable()` before `.disabled(...)`
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
